title: DarkMusic 1.5.18 Release
changelog:
• Apple Music Dynamic Background: Fluid edge-fade AGSL shader fixes black corner and border artifacts on Android 13+ devices.
• Edge Clamping & Smoothness: Seamless background blur wrapping across all tall screen aspect ratios.
• Instant Favorite Star: Tapping the star in the player immediately adds/removes favorites with zero lag.
• HD Notification Controls: High-definition notification artwork, plus instant Star and Shuffle buttons in the notification bar.
• Smooth & Natural Lyrics Scrolling: Free scrolling without accidental line clicks or phantom overlapping shadows.
• Progressive Lyrics Blur & Vocal Glow: Sharp readable upcoming lyrics with matching contrast and gentle vibration glow for sustained words.
releaseNotes: v1.5.18: Fixed animated black border/bottom spots on Android 13+ devices in Apple Music background, plus refined edge blur clamping.
